descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S20 Existing spec: a failed billing call shows an error with retry, and the retry saves the suggestion

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U15 If the billing call fails, the call is retried automatically, the note is still shown and the billing area shows a clear error with a way to retry; … (UAT Empty & Failure States (Billing suggestion failed); UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient with a generated SOAP note; the first billing call is made to fail at the Convex socket

When Open Post-Round, tap the retry control

Then The billing area shows 'Couldn’t generate billing suggestion — tap to retry'; the retry shows and saves the suggestion for that note

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in billing-suggestion.spec.ts (retry visible, two calls, saved billingForNoteAt). Not asserted by this spec: the note staying visible and the automatic retry before the error (TFA-94745 AC 4) - both are in the Empty & Failure States matrix

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S20

Existing spec: a failed billing call shows an error with retry, and the retry saves the suggestion

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local 43c38a4f, model never called: billing on this build is a server job enqueued by the note save, so every local job ran on a note with no sentence (real job, family from the frozen template, no model call) or the chart was seeded with a suggestion the app's own code built from a scripted model answer (no job); proof: no billing ai_disclosure audit row with provider_ms, tripwire clean. A note left without a suggestion (the state a job leaves after its last failed attempt: none stored, not pending) shows 'Couldn't generate billing suggestion — tap to retry' as a button, no code, no spinner, with the note still shown; tapping it queues a new attempt (attempt 2) for the same note and the card then shows the stored suggestion (both contexts, 7/7). The automatic retries before the error (5 s, then 30 s, 3 attempts, then the error; retry re-queues; a stale completion cannot overwrite) cannot be produced without a failing model call: Tim's unit test 'retries are automatic, bounded, and reject stale completions' passes (billing unit tests 230/230). Lane A: the matrix title 'a failed suggestion stays visible and retries on tap' was removed in 68f81eca; no browser test replaces it.

Evidence: 3 attached; 1 not attached:

  • newspec-c/reports/bil-unit.json — 239 KB, over 200 KB, not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec billing-suggestion.spec.ts, chromium): it seeds through the local admin key and fails the first suggestBilling call at the Convex socket (a mocked failure); dev has no admin key and the runner injects no fault there, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local matrix (lane A)] blocked (matrix/TC-18.results.json) — title not in Tim's suite on this commit (cases/e2e-titles.tsv): a failed suggestion stays visible and retries on tap
